shortBulletSummary: US CPI eased to 3.4% as expected, but crypto market impact was minimal.
Bitcoin struggled to hold gains after CPI, remaining in the $62K-$66K range.
Ethereum showed slight gains, testing key resistance levels; old whale wallets moved funds.
SEC is considering new crypto rules, while NYC launched a probe into prediction platforms.
Easing Strait of Hormuz concerns and US-Iran ceasefire hopes are boosting crypto sentiment.
